title: correspondence
description: Fields extracted from general business correspondence — the catch-all class. Its extraction schema is deliberately the loosest of the four, because this class is where documents land when they are not one of the other three.

sender_name.description: Person or organisation the letter is from.

recipient_name.description: Addressee, when the letter names one.

letter_date.description: Date on the letter, ISO 8601 date.

subject.description: Subject or Re: line, or a one-line summary when the letter has neither.

reference_number.description: Any case, claim or account reference quoted in the letter.

requires_response_by.description: Deadline the letter imposes, if any. ISO 8601 date.
